programme.title: Making Life on Earth: Attenborough's Greatest Adventure
programme.desc: In 1976, David Attenborough embarked on his most ambitious project ever, "Life on Earth". No-one had ever attempted a natural history series on this scale before. This is the hair-raising story of how the first wildlife blockbuster was born.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: The story of life, from the first primitive cells to the plants and animals that now live around us. David Attenborough goes on a world journey looking at the incredible variety of living things and fossils which throw light on the ancestry of life.

programme.title: Afoot Again in the Past
programme.desc: Esther Rantzen finds peace and tranquillity at Salisbury Cathedral, Jack Charlton visits Warkworth Castle in Northumberland and Dora Bryan celebrates the beauty of ballrooms.

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.sub-title: The Trains That Time Forgot: Britain's Lost Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Timeshift journeys back to a lost era of rail travel, when trains had names, character and style. Once the pride of the railway companies that ran them, the named train is now largely consigned to railway history. Writer and presenter Andrew Martin asks why we once named trains and why we don't do so anymore. He embarks on three railway journeys around Britain, following the routes of three of the most famous named trains - the Flying Scotsman, the Cornish Riviera Express and the Brighton Belle.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin continues to trace Hemingway's journey. He arrives in Key West in time for Hemingway's 100th birthday celebrations, where he is given boxing lessons from 83-year-old Shine Forbes who sparred with Hemingway. In Uganda, Michael has his hair cut en route up the Nile. At Butiaba, Uganda, he visits the site of a plane crash Hemingway was involved in. Finally, Michael reaches Venice in time for the carnival and then tries his hand at duck-hunting in nearby Caorle.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin stays in Ernest Hemingway's favourite Cuban hotel and samples a few of his favourite hangouts including Bodeguita del Medio and the Floridita in Old Havana. Back in the American West, Michael attempts to be a cowboy and partakes in some male bonding while visiting Yellowstone Park. He also visits the house in Ketchum, Idaho where Hemingway died in 1961 and where he was laid to rest.

programme.title: Five to Eleven
programme.desc: Emma Thompson reads poetry and prose.

programme.title: Sondheim at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the work of one of the great songwriters and lyricists, Stephen Sondheim, who passed away in November 2021 at the age of 91. A giant of musical theatre, Sondheim first found international fame in 1957 as the lyricist for Leonard Bernstein's 'West Side Story'.

programme.title: Britain's Most Fragile Treasure
programme.desc: Historian Dr Janina Ramirez unlocks the secrets of a centuries-old masterpiece in glass, the East Window at York Minster - the largest medieval stained-glass window in the country and the creative vision of a master craftsman called John Thornton. Within its 311 panels is the entire history of the world.

programme.desc: Three decades on from Manchester United's iconic Class of '92, PL Stories steps beyond the headline names to rediscover the teammates who shared the same dressing room, dreams, and demands of one of football's most revered youth systems. programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: A life-threatening head injury ended Oliver Glasner's playing career early, but it did nothing to quell his ambition. programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We delve into the remarkable story of Henrik Larsson, tracing how a young talent from Sweden rose to become one of football's most celebrated forwards. Visiting the clubs, coaches and moments that shaped him, we uncover the milestones, inspirations and unforgettable goals that forged his legacy as a player.

programme.title: Premier League Stories

Revisiting the environments and mentors that defined him, we uncover the innovation that has powered his impact at the highest level.

programme.title: Premier League Stories

Blending archive, insight and reflection, we reveal how deadline-day drama has come to define the modern Premier League era.

programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Andoni Iraola went from relative obscurity to leading a once relegation-threatened club to its highest ever points tally in the Premier League. We explore how his fearless philosophy, tactical innovation and emotional connection to the game have driven his teams to challenge expectations and rewrite their identity. A story of a Basque footballing icon, and his remarkable journey from Cyprus to the Premier League with Bournemouth in 5 years.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: With exclusive access in Germany, PL Stories follows the remarkable journey of Shinji Okazaki; from his beginnings in Japanese football to becoming a Premier League champion with Leicester City and now shaping the next generation through his club Basara Mainz.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Fresh from lifting the Africa Cup of Nations trophy with Senegal, Iliman Ndiaye reflects on a journey defined by resilience, imagination and quiet determination. From the academy pitches of France to the unforgiving grounds of non-league Boreham Wood, and on to the bright lights of the Premier League with Everton, we trace a rise that defied convention and expectation at every turn.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We mark International Women's Day by celebrating the women shaping refereeing across the professional game. We explore the past, present and future of officiating, spending a day on the road with PGMO officials Natalie Aspinall, Kirsty Dowle and Emily Carney as they open up about their journeys to the top of the game.

programme.title: Major League Baseball
programme.desc: Highlights from Major League Baseball.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We shine a spotlight on Unai Emery, tracing the journey of one of Europe's most meticulous and innovative coaches from his roots in Spain to the pinnacle of the Premier League. Through exclusive interviews with his brother and the coaches who guided him in his early years, we uncover the dedication, detail and relentless drive that shaped his rise in the game.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Ahead of the Tyne-Wear Derby, we catch up with former Newcastle striker Demba Ba at USL Dunkerque, where he is 'Head of Football Operations'. He opens up about the challenges and rewards of his new role, while reflecting on a remarkable career in the Premier League that took him to West Ham United, Newcastle United and Chelsea. From unforgettable moments on the pitch to shaping his approach off it, Ba shares insights into the experiences that continue to influence his vision for the game today.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We join Willian in Grêmio, Brazil, where he is currently continuing his playing career, as he reflects on an incredible journey in the Premier League. Sharing insights from his time at Chelsea and that controversial move across London to Arsenal and then Fulham, Willian opens up about the highs, challenges and defining moments that shaped his career at the top level of English football.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: With exclusive behind-the-scenes access, PL Stories spends time with Yakubu Aiyegbeni at Finchley Boxing Club, where he is forging a new path in the next chapter of his sporting life. We explore his growing passion for boxing and the discipline it demands, offering a fresh perspective on life after football. Alongside this new pursuit, Yakubu reflects on his remarkable journey from his early years in Nigeria to becoming one of the Premier League's most prolific and respected strikers.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Victor Moses looks back on his rise through English football, culminating in Premier League title success with Chelsea, while also opening up about the challenges faced along the way. The story continues with his more recent move to Kazakhstan, offering insight into the latest chapter of a journey that has taken him across continents.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We step inside the world of Tijjani Reijnders, joining him at home with his family in Manchester as he reflects on his remarkable rise to the top of the game. From his early beginnings to the bright lights of Manchester City, Reijnders opens up about the pivotal moments that shaped his career, the challenges he's overcome, and the ambitions that continue to drive him.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We celebrate the rise of Norwegian striking power in the Premier League, exploring how a golden generation in the late 1990s, featuring pioneers like Ole Gunnar Solskjær and Tore André Flo helped shatter stereotypes and establish Norway as an unlikely breeding ground for elite forwards. A PL Stories show that asks whether the qualities that once defined a nation's footballing identity still pulse through the DNA of its most unstoppable striker today.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We speak to Dimitar Berbatov, a player whose elegance and composure left a lasting imprint on English football. Focusing on his Premier League years, we follow his rise at Tottenham Hotspur, where his effortless style first captivated fans, through to his trophy-laden spell at Manchester United, where moments of brilliance were often matched by intense scrutiny.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We join Harry Kewell in Vietnam as he embraces a new chapter in coaching, reflecting on a career that took him from prodigious talent to Premier League star. Kewell revisits his electrifying rise at Leeds United, before confronting the intense scrutiny and expectation that came with his move to Liverpool and then Galatasaray.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton & Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs. Featuring interviews with the key figures behind Brighton's rise, alongside celebrity fans who followed every twist along the way, this documentary charts a remarkable journey of survival, ambition and one of the greatest comebacks in modern football.
